purpose: Construction examples for the final documentation additions, 2026-09-13. These are extracted input instances, not new aggregate study findings.

P7.selection: First covered cluster touch in code enumeration order; stop replay there.

P8.selection_rule: First eligible C18 week with a preceding eligible book; no return-based selection
limitations: Prices are daily candle closes indexed by opening date, not fills at the label timestamp.
The code does not require seven complete days of prior funding; missing values follow its fill and sum rules.
Target changes ignore within-week drift and are not realised execution trades.
run.py subtracts mean turnover times 0.20 from gross alpha; this example applies that proxy to one week, not a stored weekly charge.
This extraction neither estimates net alpha nor recomputes statistical inference.
Numerical instance values are not individually enumerated in the existing claim ledger.
